Hi Alex / Acme team,

Thanks for onboarding with Redwood — excited to get you set up. To unblock PO creation we need a short tax KYC checklist completed. Please attach the documents below or indicate alternatives if something isn't available: 

1) Completed and signed IRS W-9 (PDF) for the payee entity matching the invoice name.
2) A bank letter on company letterhead confirming the account name / last 4 routing digits (preferred for ACH onboarding).
3) Signatory evidence if the person signing the W-9 is not listed on company formation docs (notarized affidavit or corporate resolution).

If you cannot provide a notarized paper, we can accept one of the following alternatives: a certified IRS 147C, an e-signed W-9 via DocuSign with the signer on record, or a scanned bank letter plus Director-signed corporate resolution. 

Target timeline: if we have the W-9 + bank letter by EOD Thu 4/16 we can create a provisional PO the same day and move to payments. Otherwise we'll need an extra compliance review.

Appreciate a direct reply with attachments or a short note on which items will be submitted.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Onboarding — Procurement
Redwood Inference

- A short corporate resolution (signed by an officer) showing Maria Ortega is authorized to sign on behalf of Acme Supplies; OR
- A notarized affidavit from Maria confirming signing authority; OR
- An e-signed W-9 via DocuSign where Maria signs and the DocuSign audit trail lists her email as a verified signer.

Alex — if it's easier, we can send a DocuSign envelope for Maria to sign (we accept the DocuSign audit trail). Which approach would you prefer?

Short next steps: Alex to confirm preferred signer-evidence path by EOD Tue 4/20; Redwood to confirm PO conditional activation once we have at least one of the items above.
